<head-word>בְּדִיקָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (בָּדַק) 
<italic>search, examination, test</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. I, 1. Y. ib. I, beg. 27
<sup>a</sup> בְּדִיקַת היום ב' search (after leavened bread) made in day-time is a (valid) search. Kil. IX, 7; a. fr.—Num. R. s. 9 לב' דידיה referring to his search; i.e. intimating that the test by the ‘bitter waters’ (v. סוטה) will also affect him (the adulterer) (Sot. 28
<sup>a</sup> לידיעה).—
<plural-form>Pl. בְּדִיקוֹת;</plural-form> esp. 
<italic>cross-examinations of witnesses as to minor circumstances;</italic> v. חֲקִירָה. Snh. V, 2 (40
<sup>a</sup>); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="B00150">
<head-word>בָּדַל</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (√בד, v. 
<xref rid="B00107">בדד</xref>) 
<italic>to separate, divide, distinguish;</italic> (neut. v.) בָּדֵל 
<italic>to keep aloof</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 87
<sup>b</sup> בְּדוֹל עצמך וכ' withdraw thyself from (touching) her. Y. Ḥag. II, 78
<sup>b</sup> top כדי שיהא בָּדֵל מן התרומה in order that he may be careful in handling T’rummah. B. Mets. 59
<sup>b</sup> it seems to me שחברים בְּדֵילִים וכ' that the colleagues hold themselves aloof from thee (i.e. thou art excommunicated). Ib. 89
<sup>a</sup> ב' בתמרים to separate (with a tool) dates which stick together (cmp. Rashi a. l.); Y. Maasr. II, 50
<sup>a</sup> top הבדיל בתמרים (read הבודל). Ber. 5
<sup>a</sup> יסורין בְּדֵילִין וכ' pains will stay away from him; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִבְדִּיל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to sever, set apart, distinguish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 21
<sup>b</sup> מולק ואינו מַבְדִּיל he nips the bird’s neck but must not sever a limb or cut with his nail deeper than required (Lev. I, 17). Ib. I, 7 המבדיל בין וכ' He who established distinctions between (the) sanctity (of the Sabbath) and (the) sanctity (of the Festivals); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of אַבְדָּלָה or הַבְדָּלָה) 
<italic>to recite the benediction Hammabdil</italic> on the exit of the Sabbath or Festival, 
<italic>to say Habdalah</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ibid. כיצד מבדילין what formula must you use (at the exit of the Sabbath and the simultaneous beginning of a Festival)? a. fr.—Part. Hof. מוּבְדָּל 
<italic>separated, distinguished</italic>. Num. R. s. 10 beg. מוּבְדָּלִים וכ' are different from the doings of other nations. Naz. 7
<sup>a</sup> מוּבְדָּלוֹת זו מזו are separated one from another. Tosef. Peah III, 5; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="B00154">
<head-word>בָּדַק</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown">√בד</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> , v. 
<xref rid="B00107">בדד</xref>) 
<italic>to split, break into, penetrate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. XIII, 9 הנוה היפה בּוֹדֵק the removal to a better residence (and style of living) penetrates (the body and creates disease); v. ib. 110
<sup>b</sup> מאי ב' כדשמואל וכ' what does 
<italic>bodek</italic> mean? Answ. As it is expressed by Samuel …, a change of the mode of living (v. וֶסֶת) is the beginning of abdominal disease.—Esp. </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to search, examine, investigate, try</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. V, 1 as well as the water בּוֹדְקִין אותה וכ' tries her (eventually makes her sick), so does it try him (the adulterer). Pes. I, 1 ב' את החמץ leavened bread is searched after (for the sake of removing it). Ib. 9
<sup>b</sup> (בית) בָּדוּק a house which has been searched. Snh. III, 6 ב' את העדים the witnesses are cross-examined. Ib. IV, 5; v. דְּרִישָׁה. Sabb. 139
<sup>a</sup> וכ' בְּדוֹק בדיינו investigate the doings of the Israelitish judges. Keth. VII, 8 הוא בּוֹדְקָהּ וכ' he has her examined (as to bodily soundness) by his female relatives. Ib. 75
<sup>b</sup> חזקה אין … אא"כ בּוֹדְקוֹ the presumption is that nobody will drink out of a cup, unless he has examined it (will not marry a woman before ascertaining her physical condition). Kidd. IV, 4 צריך לבְדוֹק אחריה וכ' must investigate her family records up to four mothers &c. Ib. 5 אין בודקין מן וכ' no family records are searched beyond the altar, i.e. the ascertained fact of a person’s admission to priestly services is sufficient evidence of unblemished descent for marriage purposes. Nidd. 30
<sup>b</sup> ובדקן ומצאן (read ובדקו ומצאו) they (the scholars) examined (made a post mortem examination); Tosef. ib. IV, 17; Bekh. 45
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to tend, cure</italic> (plants), esp. 
<italic>to cover with earth or manure</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Shebi. I, 12; Y. ib. IV, 35
<sup>b</sup> bot.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִבְדַּק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be examined</italic> &c. Y. Gitt. I, 43
<sup>b</sup>; IX, end, 50
<sup>d</sup> נ' השם the report was traced.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. V, 6 נדריה נִבְדָּקִין her vows are subject to examination (to find out whether she knows the import of a vow); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="B00155">
<head-word>בְּדַק, </head-word>
<head-word>בּדִיק</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>; </definition>
<notes/></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to split, burst, break into</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 105
<sup>a</sup> חזא צינורא דבדקא וכ' (Ar. דבידקא) he saw that a sewer had burst into his field (inundating it); v. בִּדְקָא.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to examine, espy; to test</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Judg. XVIII, 2; a. fr.—Yeb. 65
<sup>a</sup> אִיבְדוֹק נפשאי I will test myself (as to my virility). Y. Ned. II, 37
<sup>b</sup> bot. בעי חיפה מִיבְדְּקוּנֵיה Ḥefa wanted to sound his knowledge. Taan. 21
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cure the body by means of a purgative</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ned. 50
<sup>b</sup> הוה בָּדִיק נפשיה וכ' purged himself with &c.; a. e.—Part. pass. בְּדִיק 
<italic>tested, sure, known</italic>. Y. Sot. V, 20
<sup>c</sup> bot. לא הוות בדיקה לי was unknown to me (I had not experienced). Taan. 23
<sup>b</sup> לא בדיקתו לי (not בדקיתו) ye are unknown to me (as to your honesty).—בְּדִיקְנָא 
<italic>I am sure, I know</italic>. Pes. 111
<sup>b</sup> בדיקנא ביה במר דלא וכ' I am sure you do not know (Ms. M. ב' ליה וכ', Ms. 2 Oxf. בקינא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). *Ḥull. 32
<sup>a</sup> לא הוה בדיקנא ביה וכ' Ar. Var. (ed. בדיחנא) I was not so familiar with my uncle that I should have asked him.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>בַּדֵּק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to discover</italic> (by sorcery), 
<italic>to find out secrets</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XLIV, 5; 15. Cmp. בְּדִיקְנָאָה.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="B00158">
<head-word>בִּדְקָא, </head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>breaking into, freshet, bursting dam</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 66
<sup>b</sup> אתא ב' וכ' a freshet came and overflooded &c. B. Bath. 41
<sup>a</sup> שקל בי' וכ' a freshet swept his field (taking away the fence). Ḥull. 105
<sup>a</sup> צינורא דב' Ar. a channel caused by a freshet, v. בְּדַק. Snh. 7
<sup>a</sup> strife is likened לצינורא דבי' (דמיא) וכ' to an inroad made by a burst (of water), once entering it widens more and more; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. בִּדְקֵי, בִּידְקֵי</plural-form>. Erub. 21
<sup>a</sup> דשכיחי בי' where freshets are of frequent occurrence.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>breach, defect</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XLII, 9 (h. ערוה). Targ. II Kings XII, 6 sq.—
<plural-form>Pl. Targ. Lam. I, 8 בִּדְקָהָא</plural-form> her shortcomings (h. עֶרְוָתָהּ). [B. Bath. 61

<entry id="B00160">
<head-word>בְּדַר</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (√בד; cmp. בזר, פזר) </definition>
<notes/></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to scatter, strew</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<italic>Pa</italic>. בַּדֵּר same, also, 
<italic>to distribute freely</italic>. Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 31; a. fr.—Ḥull. 54
<sup>a</sup> אי בַּדְּרֵי לה סמא וכ' if a powder is strewn upon its wound, it may recover; [Rashb. to B. Bath. 74
<sup>b</sup> quotes דעבד ליה סמתרי]. Gitt. 56
<sup>b</sup> ובַדְּרוּ לקיטמיה וכ' and scatter ye his (my) ashes over seven waters. Y. Ber. IX, end, 14
<sup>d</sup> בשעה דמכנשין בַּדַּר וכ' when people gather (are willing to listen to instruction), distribute (teach); when people scatter (throw religion away in neglect), gather in (live in retired study). Cant. R. to VIII, 9 בדרו גרמיכון disperse ye (do not stand in crowds).—Part. pass. מְבַדַּר 
<italic>scattered</italic>. Y. M. Kat. III, 81
<sup>d</sup> top אית סגין מנהון מְבַדְּרַן וכ' there are more than those (twenty four cases) scattered in Mishnah and Boraitha. Sabb. 20
<sup>a</sup>, v. infra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to shake</italic> (in a sieve).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Amos IX, 9. [Ibid. מחזרין, prob. מבדרין.] Cmp. בַּזֵּיל.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to tread olives</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Mic. VI, 15 (perh. בדד?).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיתְבַּדַּר, אִיבַּדַּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>; 
<italic>Ithpe.</italic> אִיתְבְּדַר, אִיבְּדַר 
<italic>to be scattered, to disperse</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Is. XXXIII, 3; a. fr.—Sabb. 20
<sup>a</sup> קנים מִיבַּדְּרִין (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300, ed. מבדרן) loose staves in the stove will fall apart (and may require stirring). Lev. R. s. 6 and the denars began מִתְבַּדְּרִין to be scattered. Gitt. 33
<sup>b</sup> ליבַּרְּרוּ אִיבַּדּוּרֵי (not איבדורו) let them disperse (so as not to be found together). Snh. 8
<sup>a</sup> bot. ואיבדור and they (the judges) dispersed.—Denom. בִּדּוּר, בִּדּוּרָא.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
